hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" | grep -q 'output/drafts'; then FOUND=$(grep -inwE 'unlock|leverage|game-changer|synergy|groundbreaking|revolutionary|transform|elevate|foster|delve|tapestry|landscape|pivotal|testament|showcase|underscore|crucial|vibrant|nestled|renowned|breathtaking|seamless|cutting-edge|paradigm|holistic|robust|empower|spearhead|beacon|cornerstone|catalyst' "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"); if [ -n "$FOUND" ]; then echo "BLOCKED: AI buzzwords detected in draft. Rewrite without these words:"; echo "$FOUND"; exit 1; fi; fi
